outcome: A Lead sees every exception they may see on one read-only list at /exceptions
acceptance_criteria: **Default list.** As `finance_lead` at 1440x900, `/exceptions` shows:

**Order kept.** The rendered titles equal the fixture `items[].title` order exactly, with no sorting. — verify: the `tests/exceptions.test.tsx` case "keeps the order returned", using a fetch stub that returns rows out of `since` order.

**Kind mapping.** Each of the five `what` values renders its tag text and class from the table above. `effect_uncertain` is the only one with `psl-tag--waiting`. — verify: `tests/exceptions.test.tsx` "maps every kind".

**Times.** `since` on the same Lagos day as `as_of` reads "since HH:mm" in WAT, and an earlier day reads "since D Mon". "As of" uses `formatWat`. — verify: unit tests with `2026-11-14T10:02:00Z` → "since 11:02" and `2026-11-10T08:30:00Z` → "since 10 Nov".
**Paging.**
**Show more failure keeps rows.** A 500 on the second page leaves the 20 rows and shows "We couldn’t load more exceptions. Choose Show more to try again." — verify: `tests/exceptions.test.tsx`.

**Empty.** `items: []` shows "No exceptions." and "Everything is moving or verified.", with no table, no Show more and no footer sentence. — verify: the unit test, and e2e with cookie `psl_mock_exceptions=empty` at 390 and 1440.
**Signed out.** A 401 shows "You’re signed out." with a Sign in link whose `next` is `/exceptions`. — verify: `tests/exceptions.test.tsx`, and e2e with cookie `psl_mock_scenario=401`.

**Wrong user.** As persona `pm`, `/exceptions` shows "This list is for Leads" and a "Go to My work" link, with no row titles, no "shown" count and no "As of". — verify: e2e with cookie `psl_mock_persona=pm`, and a unit test with a 403 stub.
**Wrong tenant / not visible.** A 404 renders the same no-access view as a 403 and shows no item data. — verify: `tests/exceptions.test.tsx` with a 404 stub, and e2e with `psl_mock_scenario=404`.

**Provider failure.** A network error or 503 on the first page shows "ERROR · COULDN’T LOAD", "We couldn’t load the exceptions. Your work is safe; nothing was changed.", "Reference <code> for support." and Try again. Try again issues one new first-page request. — verify: `tests/exceptions.test.tsx`.

**No actions.** In every state, the list renders no `button` other than Show more and Try again, and no link other than the title links, "Go to My work", "Sign in" and (in compact mode) "See all exceptions". — verify: a unit test that queries all buttons and links in the default state and asserts the allowed set.
**Compact embed.** `<ExceptionsList compact limit={10} maxRows={3} />`:

**Reusable exports.** `src/features/exceptions/index.ts` exports `ExceptionsList` and `useExceptions`, and nothing in `src/features/exceptions/**` imports from `src/app/**`. — verify: the file content, and `grep -r "@/app\|src/app" frontend/src/features/exceptions` returns nothing.

**Phone layout.** At 390x844, `/exceptions` shows the rows as cards (tag, since, title link, doing, "Who acts: …"), with no horizontal scroll (`document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 390`). The Show more and Try again targets are at least 44px tall. — verify: e2e.
**Accessibility (A-ACCESSIBILITY).** axe reports no violations (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa) for:
**Mock contract.**
**Rows match items.** For every row in `E-EXCEPTIONS.json`:

**Rows open their item.** Clicking the first row's title on `/exceptions` opens `/work/W-1005`, which shows "Kora Logistics · Milestone 1 invoice". Clicking a W-15xx row opens its own item, not the default fixture. — verify: e2e.
**Work item link.**
**Shared edits stay small.**

risk.rationale: I rated it low. The feature is a read-only list with no writes, no CSRF-bearing calls, no amounts and no external messaging. The backend does the grant filtering ("Leads; filtered by grants", handoff.md:4284). The frontend only has to render 401 and 403 correctly and offer no actions. Surfaces are `ui` (a new route and states) and `api` (it consumes a new endpoint through the mock). The small shared edits to `server.mjs` and `WorkItemOverview.tsx` are additive and contained, so they do not add a contract-change surface. Product acceptance is required: this is a new screen for the client, and SCR-10 is built without the reference, search, filter and total (PMO-0-1), so the design engineer must see the reduced board.

findings.summary: `frontend/src/features/exceptions/labels.ts` `sinceText` (and `formatWat`, which F-03 owns): `Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatToParts` throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` for a malformed timestamp, so one bad `since` or `as_of` would crash the whole list render. The contract promises RFC 3339 strings, so this is a hardening item. Fix by guarding in `sinceText` or with an error boundary, or leave it and note it in the backend contract tests.

`frontend/src/features/exceptions/ExceptionsList.tsx:128`: the `limit` prop is read only as the initial value (`useExceptions({ limit: initialLimit })`). A later prop change is ignored. Spec-compliant for the current callers, but F-08 may pass a different limit. Either document it as initial-only or sync it.

`frontend/mock/server.mjs:24` (`M1_OPERATIONS`): the array line is the same line F-05, F-07 and F-08 are likely to append to, so a merge conflict is probable. The integration owner should resolve it at merge time. The change itself is correct.

On desktop the "since <t>" text sits right after each tag, so its left edge shifts row to row (tag widths differ). The board uses a fixed tag column. Optional: give the tag a fixed-width slot. src/features/exceptions/exceptions.css

`frontend/src/features/exceptions/useExceptions.ts` (`fetchPage`) and `ExceptionsList.tsx` (search form, Filter): `q` and `what` are sent to `/api/v1/exceptions` and the search box and Filter are always shown, though neither parameter exists in v4 to v6 (only `cursor`, `limit`). Expected: the page works against the real contract. Actual: with a backend that ignores unknown query params, typing a search or choosing a kind shows a chip and the same unfiltered rows, a silent wrong result; with one that validates them, the list fails. Fix: show Search and Filter only once a page has carried `open_count` (the proposal's capability signal), or filter client-side across loaded rows, and add a test for a response with no `open_count` that shows neither control and sends no `q`/`what`. The backend must otherwise add the parameters to the contract first.

findings.summary: `frontend/tests/mock-contract.test.ts` and `tests/exceptions-mock.test.ts`: the contract check strips fields from the response but never checks that the request query (`q`, `what`) is declared. Add a test that records which query names the page sends, so the gap in TECH-2-1 stays visible until the architecture adds them.

`useExceptions.ts` `showMore`: `openCount` is overwritten by each Show more page. If a backend sends it only on page 1 the "N OPEN" count disappears after Show more. Keep the earlier value when a later page omits it.

carried over, TECH-1-1 (malformed `since` or `as_of` throws in `sinceText`), TECH-1-2 (`limit` prop initial-only, now documented), TECH-1-3 (`M1_OPERATIONS` merge conflict, integration, now a one-line change again).

Keyboard focus is lost after a rows-per-page change or "Clear search and filter". `ExceptionsList.tsx:172` and `:249`: a radio change calls `setLimit`, and the hook (`useExceptions.ts:42`) sets `loading`. That replaces the body, including the paging bar, with `LoadingState`, so the focused radio is removed. Expected: focus stays on the chosen radio, so the arrow keys keep working (ARIA radiogroup pattern). Actual: after one ArrowLeft from "20", `document.activeElement` is BODY, a second ArrowLeft does nothing, and the next Tab lands on the first row link. A click on "10" and "Clear search and filter" (`:210`) also leave focus on BODY. My work (`/my-work`) behaves the same way, so this is a shared pattern and not new here. Fix both screens together: keep the loaded rows and bar mounted during a reload, or move focus back to the checked radio and the search box.

Search and Filter are not kept when the person goes back. I searched "Northwind" (3 rows), opened /work/W-1503, then used browser Back. /exceptions showed 20 unfiltered rows and an empty search box. The spec does not require this, so it is a UX note: a Lead working through a narrowed list loses it after each row.

The search box disappears while the list shows an error. `ExceptionsList.tsx:293` sets `searchable = state.status !== 'error'`. I searched "kora" and stubbed a 503: the error card appeared and the search box was gone, so the person cannot see or clear the search that failed. Try again reloads with the hidden "kora" and brings the box back with its text. Also, when a kind is chosen the Filter button's accessible name becomes "Filter 1" (the badge text). A visually hidden "kind selected" label would read better.

The mock serves fields and query parameters the typed contract forbids (`q`, `what`, `open_count`, row `ref`). The v6 response has `additionalProperties: false`. The proposal must reach the backend developer through v7 and be confirmed (or the types in `features/exceptions/types.ts` change with it) before any real-backend wiring. Until then, QA's "Unproved" list stands: a backend that ignores `q`/`what` would show an unfiltered list that looks filtered. Do not describe this slice as integration-ready. Authority for carrying it: D-05.

The feature record is still incomplete (carried from PMO-1-2). `operation_ids` in feature.json is empty although E-EXCEPTIONS is in scope, and `baseline.architecture_manifest_sha256` is null although the spec cites the v5 digest a91bc3ce....
